billing.faq1A: Ana buƙatar tabbatar da katin yayin rajista. Ana ba da cikakken dama na kwanaki 7 ba tare da caji ba. Bayan gwajin, za a caje €120/wata ta atomatik. Soke kafin kwanaki 7 don guje wa caji.
billing.faq2A: Duk shirye-shiryen suna ba da cikakken dama ga duk fasalulluka na sabis. Enterprise kuma ya haɗa da saitin musamman don alamar ku da gudanar da kafofin watsa labarun a sikelin ta hanyar API ɗinmu (muna sarrafa asusu a gare ku).
billing.faq2Q: Menene bambanci tsakanin Premium da Enterprise?
billing.faq3A: Kuna haɗa maɓallan API ɗinku don sabis na waje (Google Veo, FAL/Kling, Runway, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Claude). TrendFlow yana amfani da su don samar da bidiyo/murya/avatar. Kuna biya waɗannan sabis kai tsaye a farashinsu.
billing.faq3Q: Menene 'samarwa ta hanyar haɗin API' ke nufi?
billing.faq4A: Ee, binciken yanayi da nazari ba su da iyaka akan shirye-shiryen Premium da Enterprise.
billing.faq4Q: Shin nazarin yanayi ba shi da iyaka da gaske?
billing.faq5A: Ee, kowane lokaci daga katin shirin da ke sama. Za a kashe sabuntawa ta atomatik, kuma samun dama zai ci gaba har zuwa ƙarshen lokacin biya.
billing.faq6A: Ee. Shigar da lambar talla a sama; za a yi amfani da rangwamen lokacin yin rajista ga Premium ta hanyar Stripe.

billing.faq49Q1: Yaya gwajin kyauta na kwanaki 7 ke aiki?
billing.faq49A1: A wurin biya dole ne ku tabbatar da katin banki ta hanyar Stripe — wajibi ne, amma ba a caji komai na kwanaki 7 kuma kuna samun cikakken damar shiga. Lokacin da gwajin ya ƙare, ana caji €49/wata ta atomatik. Soke kafin kwanaki 7 su ƙare kuma ba za a caje ku komai ba.
billing.faq49A2: Autopilot shell: binciken yanayi da analytics, manufar masu sauraro, UGC studio, Chrome extension, Publisher tare da tsarin abun ciki, autopilot da Gallery. Samar da AI da kansa ba a haɗa shi ba — yana gudana ta hanyar biyan kuɗin ku (Google Flow, NotebookLM, HeyGen) ko API keys ɗin ku, kuma kuna biyan masu samarwa kai tsaye a farashinsu.
billing.faq49Q3: Me yasa biyan kuɗi ya fi rahusa fiye da API?
billing.faq49A3: Masu samarwa suna sayar da kuɗin biyan kuɗi mai rahusa fiye da sakan guda ta hanyar API: Veo akan biyan kuɗi na Google AI ya fi rahusa sau 2–10, HeyGen avatars kusan sau 3 sun fi rahusa. Kuma NotebookLM ba shi da API na jama'a kwata-kwata — biyan kuɗi kawai. Extension ɗin yana sarrafa aikin a cikin asusun ku, yana ba ku dacewa kamar API a farashin biyan kuɗi. Ainihin lambobi suna cikin tebur da kalkuleta a sama.
billing.faq49A4: Biyu sun isa don farawa: Google AI Pro (€21.99/wata — Flow bidiyo + NotebookLM tare da iyakoki mafi girma) da HeyGen Creator ($29/wata — kimanin minti 30 na Avatar IV). Kowane sabis kuma yana da iyakoki kyauta (Flow — 50 credits/rana, NotebookLM — 3 overviews/rana, HeyGen — 3 videos/wata), don haka zaku iya gwada pipeline ba tare da biyan kuɗi ba.
billing.faq49Q5: Zan iya aiki da API keys kawai?
billing.faq49A5: Haka ne. Haɗa keys ɗin ku (Google Veo, FAL/Kling, Runway, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Claude) a cikin Saituna kuma sabis ɗin yana samarwa da su kai tsaye, ba a buƙatar extension. Kuna biyan waɗannan sabis ɗin a farashinsu. Hanyoyin suna haɗuwa kyauta: avatars akan biyan kuɗi, voice-over ta hanyar API, misali.
billing.faq49Q6: Yaya zan soke? Ina maɓallin yake?
billing.faq49A6: A saman wannan shafin, a cikin katin "Tsarin ku", maɓallin "Kashe sabuntawa ta atomatik" yana bayyana yayin da biyan kuɗi ke aiki. Ba a mayar da kuɗin lokutan da aka biya, amma damar tana ci gaba har sai lokacin ya ƙare. Kashe shi yayin gwaji kuma ba za a caje ku ko kaɗan ba. Kuna iya ci gaba da dannawa ɗaya kowane lokaci kafin lokacin ya ƙare.
billing.faq49A7: Eh. Shigar da lambar talla a sama — rangwamen yana aiki a wurin biyan kuɗi na Premium ta hanyar Stripe.
billing.disclaimer49: TrendTraffic ba shi da alaƙa da Google, HeyGen, ElevenLabs ko Blotato. Fadada yana sarrafa aiki a cikin asusun ku — bi sharuɗɗan sabis na kowane mai bayarwa. An samo farashin masu bayarwa daga jerin farashi na hukuma tun daga Yuli 2026 kuma suna iya canzawa.

landing.featIntro: VibeVox yana aiki kai tsaye a cikin burauzarka. Ƙirƙiri ɗakin taro da danna 1, kwafi hanyar haɗin, kuma aika shi ga abokin hulɗarka a WhatsApp ko Telegram — suna haɗawa nan take, kuma duka biyun suna jin juna an fassara su zuwa harshensu na asali. Babu buƙatar rajista ga abokin tarayya.
landing.featLearnText: AI Learning Hub yana daidaitawa da ƙamus ɗinka na musamman da yarukan yanki 96 — Larabcin Masar, Sifaniyancin Latin Amurka. Cikin awa 1 kawai na amfani.

landing.featPriceText: Mafi ƙarancin farashin dillali a kasuwar fassarar lokaci guda. Biyan kuɗin mintuna na ainihi da aka fassara kawai — babu biyan kuɗi ko kwangilar shekara-shekara.

landing.featVoiceText: Muryoyin HD Aoede da Charon. Gemini yana fassara sauti kai tsaye zuwa sauti — babu STT→rubutu→TTS sarkar. Ƙasa da 0.5 seconds jinkiri, tattaunawa tana gudana a zahiri.

landing.heroLead: Fassarar nan take mai hanya biyu don tarurrukan bidiyo da kiran SIP a cikin harsuna 100+. Muryoyin HD, ƙasa da 0.5 seconds jinkiri, kawai €0.17 a minti.
landing.hintsText: A cikin wayar SIP, AI tana rubuta tattaunawar a ainihin lokacin kuma tana nuna shirye-shiryen amsoshi ga manaja. Bayan kiran — matsaloli, abubuwan da ke haifar da su, da alamomi suna shiga CRM (Chatwoot, Questflow) ta atomatik. Haɗa zuwa Zadarma, Twilio, da kowane ƙofar SIP.

landing.langsText: Kana magana da harshenka — abokin hulɗarka yana jin fassarar a nasu. Suna amsawa — nan take kana jin su a {{lang}}. A lokaci guda, ba tare da jinkiri ba, ba tare da lafazi ba.

ttLanding.f1Ph: Hoton allo: abubuwan da ke faruwa
ttLanding.f1Text: Bincika dandamali uku ta niche da yanki. "Manufar masu sauraro": bayyana samfurinka — AI zai cika masu sauraro ta atomatik, zaɓi kalmomin shiga a cikin harsuna 29, kuma nemo niches tare da ainihin buƙata. Tashoshin masu fafatawa a cikin jerin kallo tare da tarihin ma'auni.
ttLanding.f1Title: Abubuwan da ke faruwa — kafin kowa
ttLanding.f2Text: Liƙa hanyar haɗi zuwa kowane bidiyo na TikTok, Instagram, ko YouTube — Gemini zai raba shi kowane firam: ƙugiya, rhythm, tsari, rubutun. Rushewar da subtitles za su shiga gallery, kuma "TrendDNA" zai jagoranci bidiyonka na gaba ta atomatik.
ttLanding.f2Title: Girke-girke na viral — firam da firam
ttLanding.f3Text: Hanyoyi huɗu: solo, tattaunawa ta mutane biyu, rubutunka "kamar yadda yake", jagoranci bisa nazarin abubuwan da ke faruwa. Shirye-shiryen HeyGen ko avatar daga hotonka, duk muryoyin ElevenLabs ciki har da clones, salon subtitles na kai tsaye, da kayan aikin alama.
ttLanding.f3Title: Avatar yana magana a gare ka
ttLanding.f4Text: Kula da abubuwan da ke faruwa yana juya abubuwan da aka gano zuwa shirye-shiryen bidiyo bisa ga samfurinka. Sarƙoƙin bugawa ta atomatik suna rarraba tsarin a duk faɗin dandamali da ramummuka — TikTok, YouTube, da Instagram suna karɓar abun ciki akan jadawali.
ttLanding.f4Title: Tsarin abun ciki na wata-wata — ba tare da kai ba

ttLanding.priceBody: Premium — cikakken damar zuwa duk modules. Kwanaki 7 na farko kyauta, babu caji, soke kowane lokaci.
ttLanding.savBody: Tsarin mu na Chrome extension yana haɗa sabis na AI ta amfani da biyan kuɗin ku na yanzu maimakon biyan kuɗin API. Kuma maɓallan ku na kanku (BYOK) — Gemini, ElevenLabs, TikHub, Blotato — suna aiki kai tsaye, ba tare da ƙarin farashi ba.

ttLanding.stBody: Binciken abubuwan da ke faruwa, nazarin bidiyo masu yaduwa, avatars, muryoyi, fassarori, bidiyo masu sarrafa kansu, da kuma wallafa kai tsaye—duka a wuri guda. Haɗa maɓallan sabis ɗinku ko biyan kuɗi kuma ku biya ta hanyar da ta fi dacewa da ku.

ttLanding.step1Text: Mai binciken mu yana rufe TikTok, Instagram, da YouTube bisa ga niche ɗinku, yanki, da harshe. Mai niyya na AI ɗin mu yana gano ƙananan niches da kalmomin maɓalli, yana sanya su ta hanyar buƙatar gaske.
ttLanding.step2Text: Nazarin Gemini yana raba bidiyo masu yaduwa zuwa ƙugiya, rhythm, da tsari. Kuna samun TrendDNA—girke-girke don ɗakin bidiyo ɗinku, tare da fassarori na asali.
ttLanding.step3Text: Ɗakin UGC ɗin mu yana ƙirƙirar bidiyo na avatar na AI: salo shirye-shirye ko avatar daga hoton ku, muryoyin ElevenLabs a cikin harsuna 29, yanke-yanke, fassarori, da kuma kayan alama. Tsarin 9:16 da 16:9.
ttLanding.step4Text: Autopilot yana sa ido kan abubuwan da ke faruwa kuma yana haɗa bidiyo ta amfani da samfura, yayin da Mai wallafawa ke tsara su na kwanaki 35 a gaba: 9:16 don TikTok, 16:9 don YouTube.
